{{Quote|A week ago, Wedge vaporized the Emperor and half the Imperial High Command.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], about [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]|<ref name="RL1">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Imperial High Command''', also known as '''Imperial Central Command''' or simply '''Imperial Command''', was the central command division responsible for coordinating the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. 

By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Redd Wessel]] was the leader of the Imperial Central Command.
